why: Wyoming State Parks' own Broken Arrow page (wyoparks.wyo.gov/index.php/about-our-campgrounds/1685-broken-arrow-glendo, read as search-result text 2026-11-20; the site itself refuses with an F5 challenge) says the access road past the Indian Point Ramp 'is a dirt road, with several sandy areas' and 'Heavy precipitation can quickly make the road impassable, or at least difficult terrain, and as a result, we recommend camping at Broken Arrow only with smaller camping units and 4wheel drive vehicles'; Campflare (FacilityId 333 page, read 2026-11-20) repeats it: 'The park recommends smaller units and four-wheel-drive vehicles for this campground.' A standing agency 4WD recommendation (not limited to wet weather) on the only way in = skip (user_ekko_no_4wd).
name: Glendo State Park (Broken Arrow Campground)

Not in the DB (no name match; nearest entries 13976 Sandy Beach 3.1 km and 13968 Bennett Hill 3.3 km). Fails on access: agency 4WD recommendation (see why).
flags: Skipped on the agency's 4WD recommendation for the sandy dirt road past Indian Point Ramp. The sentence gives heavy precipitation as the reason, but the recommendation itself is unconditional ('only with smaller camping units and 4wheel drive vehicles'); if AWH reads it as weather-conditional or confirms 2WD access, the add data is all here: 16 grass-pad non-electric sites + 1 group site, 60-100 ft parking, $10 base (Glendo schedule as 13969), vault toilet only (no water listed), reservations May 15 - Sep 15, park open year-round.

Waterfront not audited (skip). 3DEP lidar (epqs.nationalmap.gov, 2026-11-20) puts the unit points at 1415.0-1417.6 m, 1.5-4 m above Glendo full pool (1413.5 m NAVD88), so an add would need a real lakefront audit; a Dyrt reviewer reports 'great access to the water'; the engine tags every unit 'Waterfront Setting: None'.

Glendo full pool for the next nine leads: top of active conservation 4635.0 ft (USBR project page usbr.gov/projects/index.php?id=290 'Top of Active Conservation Pool (Elevation) 4635.0 ft', via search-result text; the park's own pages also call 4635.0 full) on Reclamation's project datum tied to NGVD29 (data.usbr.gov catalog 4553 / 2003 sedimentation survey) = 1412.75 m NGVD29 = 1413.51 m NAVD88 at Broken Arrow and 1413.53 m at Custer Cove (NOAA NCAT llh API, NGVD29->NAVD88, +0.77 m, read 2026-11-20).
